must_fix.issue: Make product-class framing a hard gate before scoring Inputs & Assumptions; quarantine or reject plant-economic drivers for instrument devices unless explicitly wired to an instrument capital model.
must_fix.why: The organoid bioreactor floor of 1.2 demonstrates that Anvil currently permits irrelevant plant assumptions to enter an instrument dossier and scorecard. A universal engine must apply common evidence contracts while selecting valid class-specific content.
must_fix.test: Implement test_instrument_no_plant_lcoe_frame.py using an instrument fixture containing sale-price, feedstock, annual-volume or LCOE rows; assert these rows are rejected, quarantined, or explicitly evidenced as part of a capital model, and assert they cannot appear in the instrument Financial model.

must_fix.issue: Prune, classify, or separately score consumable and ghost ledger topology before evaluating connection-trace completeness for instruments.
must_fix.why: A score of 3.3 caused by one rendered connection against 36 ledger edges is a category error where the ledger is treated as an electrical or fluidic topology source without class-aware filtering. This prevents otherwise valid instrument packs from meeting the common score floor.
must_fix.test: Implement test_connection_trace_ghost_ratio.py with an instrument ledger fixture containing real nets plus consumables, procurement-only lines and non-rendered administrative edges; assert only topology-relevant edges count towards trace coverage and that unclassified ghost edges fail explicitly.

must_fix.issue: Promote cover PDF, cover HTML and relative-link click index into a shared pack-build stage.
must_fix.why: The FE-front cover was manually assembled, so a high-quality customer navigation layer is not reproducible across product classes. Universal pack content requires a common generated cover contract, not agent-specific care.
must_fix.test: Implement test_cover_relative_links.py that builds a fixture pack through scripts/lib/build_pack_cover.py, parses all local HTML href values, and confirms each resolves within the pack root without absolute machine paths.

must_fix.issue: Make detailed general-arrangement generation a declared, common pack-stage contract rather than an optional FE-front invocation.
must_fix.why: A supposedly universal drawing module is insufficient if individual twin pipelines can bypass it. Product classes may have distinct drawing content, but each must satisfy a common drawing deliverable and evidence gate.
must_fix.test: Add a multi-class drawing-stage test for Formula E and organoid fixtures that asserts the pack either contains drawings/general-arrangement.png generated through the shared stage or contains an explicit, approved not-applicable record with a class rationale.

must_fix.issue: Centralise PACK_LAYOUT_V1 and require every pack builder to consume it, with dual-class smoke-pack validation.
must_fix.why: Replacing em-honesty/ with electromagnetics/ fixes one customer-facing path, but does not prove that all builders share layout rules or that instrument and plant packs remain valid. Current pack consistency is still dependent on individual pipeline behaviour.
must_fix.test: Implement test_pack_layout_schema.py and a dual-class smoke job that builds or validates Formula E and organoid packs, asserts PACK_LAYOUT_V1 compliance, required cover and manifest files, valid conditional evidence folders, and absence of forbidden path segments including em-honesty/.

must_fix.issue: Split motor-specific jack EM phases from the universal exporter into a capability-driven electromagnetics interface.
must_fix.why: Motor-specific phases embedded in a universal exporter make the architecture FE-front shaped. A universal engine must select EM evidence from declared product capabilities, allow genuinely non-EM products to omit it or provide a not-applicable note, and avoid fabricated field plots.
must_fix.test: Add capability-matrix pack tests covering a motor with EM evidence, an instrument without EM capability, and a product with screen-driven multiphysics; assert valid conditional directories and prohibit motor-only phases from running for non-motor fixtures.

must_fix.issue: Enforce ANVIL_TAB_FLOOR=9 at send-pack time and close the bioreactor's evidence defects without score inflation.
must_fix.why: Stage discipline alone does not establish universality if one class can ship with a 1.2 dossier floor while another receives bespoke remediation. The common quality bar must be mechanically enforced for every scored tab, excluding only formally defined mirrors and out-of-scope tabs.
must_fix.test: Add a send-pack gate regression with failing and passing scorecard fixtures; assert any scored tab below 9 blocks shipment, mirrors and formally OOS tabs are treated according to registry rules, and source-evidence failures cannot be overridden by edited scores.

safe_change_order: Define PACK_LAYOUT_V1, conditional-folder rules and forbidden path segments in one shared module; migrate current builders without changing evidence content.
Add independent layout-schema and customer-path regressions, then validate existing Formula E and organoid packs or fixtures.
Implement the shared cover-build stage and relative-link click index; require it for all send packs.
Introduce capability declarations for electromagnetics, PCB, multiphysics and drawings; extract motor-specific jack EM phases behind the EM capability interface.
Make the detailed general-arrangement stage part of the common drawing contract, with explicit approved not-applicable handling where genuinely required.
Add instrument-versus-plant frame validation before workbook densification and scoring; remove or properly wire the bioreactor's orphan plant drivers.
Implement topology classification and connection-trace pruning; repair the bioreactor's rendered and ledger topology evidence.
Resolve bioreactor verification HARD opens, PCB PnP evidence, overview invariants and BoM required-cell gaps from source artefacts rather than score edits.
Enable ANVIL_TAB_FLOOR=9 as a mandatory send-pack gate and rerun Formula E plus organoid dual-class smoke packs after each product-class-affecting change.
Ship the bioreactor only after every scored tab is at least 9.0 and the generated pack contains the schema-compliant cover PDF, HTML and relative links.
tests_required: test_pack_customer_evidence_dir.py: retain and run on every change; reject em-honesty/ and other internal-only customer path segments.
test_pack_layout_schema.py: validate PACK_LAYOUT_V1, dossier and manifest presence, conditional evidence-folder handling, renders and drawings requirements, and forbidden paths.
Dual-class smoke-pack test: build or validate Formula E front MGU and organoid bioreactor packs from independent fixtures or cached twins.
test_instrument_no_plant_lcoe_frame.py: ensure plant LCOE and operational-finance drivers cannot contaminate an instrument financial frame.
test_connection_trace_ghost_ratio.py: ensure procurement, consumable and administrative ledger lines cannot dominate physical connection-trace scoring.
test_cover_relative_links.py: ensure generated cover HTML and click-index links resolve only beneath the pack root and do not contain local absolute paths.
Capability-matrix exporter test: motor EM, non-EM instrument and multiphysics-capable product each receive valid conditional content without fabricated artefacts.
Common drawing-stage test: confirm all applicable classes invoke the shared GA contract or emit a justified not-applicable record.
Send-pack tab-floor gate test: block packs with any scored tab below 9.0 while applying registered mirror and out-of-scope exclusions only.
Bioreactor regression fixture: preserve failures for orphan drivers, ghost topology, verification HARD opens and incomplete BoM cells until source-backed remediation passes.
terra.one_line: Anvil has universal intent and some shared controls, but it remains only partially universal because FE-front-specific pipeline care is not yet encoded as mandatory, capability-driven and independently tested pack contracts for instruments and plants.
